units.locator: Article 32. Powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life
units.text: 20. When exercising the powers established by part 1 of this Article, local self-government bodies are authorized to procure goods, work and services. When exercising the powers established by part 2 or 3 of this Article (taking account of their redistribution), local self-government bodies and/or state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation are authorized to procure goods, work and services.
units.label: Part 20 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 33. Exercise of individual state powers by local self-government bodies
units.text: Article 33. Exercise of individual state powers by local self-government bodies
units.label: Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Exercise of individual state powers by local self-government bodies
units.text: 1. Constituent entities of the Russian Federation may delegate to local self-government bodies the exercise of individual state powers exercised by those constituent entities in the territories of the respective municipalities, in accordance with Article 34 of this Federal Law and Federal Law of 21.12.2021 No. 414-ФЗ “On the General Principles of the Organization of Public Authority in Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation”, which establishes the general principles for the organization of public authority in a constituent entity, provided that the material resources and financial means necessary to exercise those powers are transferred to the local self-government bodies.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Exercise of individual state powers by local self-government bodies
units.text: 2. Local self-government bodies bear responsibility for exercising delegated powers of the Russian Federation and powers of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation within the subventions provided to local budgets to finance the exercise of the corresponding powers.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.label: Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 1. Local self-government bodies are vested with individual state powers of the Russian Federation by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and with individual state powers of constituent entities of the Russian Federation by laws of those constituent entities.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 2. Individual state powers of the Russian Federation delegated for exercise by state authorities of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may be delegated by laws of that constituent entity to local self-government bodies in accordance with the procedure established by this Article, if the right to do so is granted by the federal laws delegating the corresponding powers of the Russian Federation to state authorities of its constituent entities, and unless otherwise provided by regulatory legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation or regulatory legal acts of the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 3. Local self-government bodies may be vested with individual state powers for an unlimited period or, if the powers have a fixed period of validity, for that period.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 4. The exercise of delegated powers is financed through subventions from the relevant budget. Local self-government bodies may additionally use their own property (material resources and financial means) to exercise individual state powers delegated to them, in the cases and in accordance with the procedure provided for by the municipal charter.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 5. Provisions of federal laws and laws of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers enter into force at the beginning of the next financial year; those federal laws and constituent entity laws must be adopted no later than two months before that year begins.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 6. A federal law or law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers must contain:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 1) the type or name of the municipality whose local self-government bodies are vested with the corresponding powers;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 2) a list of the rights and duties of local self-government bodies and of state authorities in exercising the corresponding powers;
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 3) a method (methodology) for calculating the standards used to determine the total amount of subventions provided to local budgets from the federal budget and the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation to exercise the corresponding powers, including federal or regional state minimum social standards. The total amount of subventions provided to local budgets from the federal budget and the constituent entity’s budget must be determined taking into account the costs of organizing the exercise of delegated powers of the Russian Federation and powers of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 6 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 4) a list of property to be transferred for use and/or management that is necessary to exercise the individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies, or the procedure for determining that list;
units.label: Point 4 Part 6 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 5) the procedure for local self-government bodies to report on the exercise of the individual state powers delegated to them;
units.label: Point 5 Part 6 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 6) the procedure for state authorities to oversee the exercise of individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies, and the names of the bodies exercising that oversight;
units.label: Point 6 Part 6 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 7) the conditions and procedure for terminating the exercise by local self-government bodies of the individual state powers delegated to them.
units.label: Point 7 Part 6 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 7. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation vesting local self-government bodies with state powers of the Russian Federation delegated for exercise by state authorities of that constituent entity must also contain provisions determining:
units.label: Part 7 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 1) the rights and duties of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation relating to the exercise by local self-government bodies of delegated state powers of the Russian Federation, analogous to the rights and duties of federal executive authorities relating to the exercise of delegated powers and provided for by the federal law under which those powers are delegated for exercise by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, insofar as establishing such rights and duties does not conflict with federal laws;
units.label: Point 1 Part 7 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 2) the rights and duties of local self-government bodies relating to the exercise of state powers of the Russian Federation delegated to them, analogous to the rights and duties of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation relating to the exercise of delegated powers and provided for by the federal law under which those powers are delegated for exercise by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, insofar as establishing such rights and duties does not conflict with federal laws.
units.label: Point 2 Part 7 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 8. When a draft law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers is submitted to the legislative body of that constituent entity, the holder or holders of the right of legislative initiative must submit an opinion on the draft law from the council of municipalities of the relevant constituent entity.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 9. State authorities, in accordance with federal law, oversee the exercise of individual state powers by local self-government bodies and the use of property provided for those purposes.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Procedure for vesting local self-government bodies with individual state powers
units.text: 10. If violations of statutory requirements concerning the exercise of individual state powers by local self-government bodies or local self-government officials are identified, the corresponding powers may be withdrawn in accordance with the procedure provided for by this Federal Law. Authorized state bodies may issue written orders to remedy such violations that are binding on local self-government bodies and officials. Those orders may be challenged in court.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 35. Procedure for withdrawing individual state powers from local self-government bodies
units.text: Article 35. Procedure for withdrawing individual state powers from local self-government bodies
units.label: Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Procedure for withdrawing individual state powers from local self-government bodies
units.text: 1. Individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies are withdrawn by federal laws or laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, respectively.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Procedure for withdrawing individual state powers from local self-government bodies
units.text: 2. Federal laws and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation providing for the withdrawal of individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies enter into force at the beginning of the next financial year.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 36. Participation of local self-government bodies in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them
units.text: Article 36. Participation of local self-government bodies in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them
units.label: Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Participation of local self-government bodies in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them
units.text: 1. On matters concerning the exercise of individual state powers by local self-government bodies, federal executive authorities and executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation may, in the cases established by federal laws and laws of constituent entities and within their competence, issue binding regulatory legal acts and oversee their implementation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Participation of local self-government bodies in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them
units.text: 2. Federal laws establishing the right of local self-government bodies to participate in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them under Article 34 of this Federal Law may contain provisions allowing and defining the limits of legal regulation of those powers by state authorities.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Participation of local self-government bodies in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them
units.text: 3. Local self-government bodies participate in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them under Article 34 of this Federal Law if the municipal representative body decides to exercise the right to participate in the exercise of those powers.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Participation of local self-government bodies in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them
units.text: 4. Local self-government bodies may incur expenditure from the municipal budget (excluding funds transferred to the local budget for earmarked expenditure) to exercise powers not delegated to them under Article 34 of this Federal Law, if federal laws allow such expenditure.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Participation of local self-government bodies in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them
units.text: 5. Local self-government bodies may establish additional social support and social assistance measures for individual categories of citizens from municipal budget funds (excluding funds transferred to the local budget for earmarked expenditure), irrespective of whether federal laws contain provisions establishing that right.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Participation of local self-government bodies in the exercise of state powers not delegated to them
units.text: 6. Financing the powers provided for in this Article is not an obligation of the municipality, is undertaken where resources permit, and does not constitute a ground for allocating additional funds from other budgets of the budget system of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.label: Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 1. Local self-government bodies may exercise powers not assigned to them as powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life using local budget revenues, excluding interbudgetary transfers provided from budgets of the budget system of the Russian Federation and tax revenue received under additional revenue-sharing rates.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 2. Local self-government bodies have the right to:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 1) exercise powers in the field of strategic planning provided for by federal legislation on strategic planning in the Russian Federation, including approval of the municipality’s socioeconomic development strategy;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 2) establish a municipal fire service;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 3) create conditions for organizing independent assessments of the quality of conditions under which organizations provide services, in accordance with the procedure and on the conditions established by federal laws; use the results of such assessments when evaluating the performance of heads of subordinate organizations; and, in accordance with federal laws, monitor the adoption of measures to remedy shortcomings identified by such assessments;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 4) establish municipal higher education organizations;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 5) create conditions for the development of tourism;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 6) establish municipal museums;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 7) promote the development of physical culture and sport for persons with disabilities and persons with health-related limitations, and of adaptive physical culture and adaptive sport;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 8) support public associations of persons with disabilities and organizations established by all-Russian public associations of persons with disabilities, in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on social protection of persons with disabilities;
units.label: Point 8 Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 9) perform notarial acts provided for by legislation if there is no notary in a settlement that forms part of the municipality’s territory and is not its administrative center;
units.label: Point 9 Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 10) assist notaries in receiving members of the public in accordance with the reception schedule approved by the notarial chamber of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 10 Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 11) provide citizens with accommodation from the municipal housing stock under tenancy agreements for housing in the housing stock for social use, in accordance with housing legislation;
units.label: Point 11 Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 12) provide accommodation to an officer holding the position of district police commissioner and the officer’s family members for the period during which the officer holds that position;
units.label: Point 12 Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 13) carry out activities relating to the handling of ownerless animals living in the municipality;
units.label: Point 13 Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 14) implement measures to assist persons in a state of intoxication caused by alcohol, narcotics or other toxic substances;
units.label: Point 14 Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 15) participate in measures to prevent the unlawful consumption of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances and drug addiction;
units.label: Point 15 Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 16) implement measures to prevent offenses in accordance with Federal Law of 23.06.2016 No. 182-ФЗ “On the Fundamentals of the System for Preventing Offenses in the Russian Federation”;
units.label: Point 16 Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 17) establish public councils attached to local self-government bodies in accordance with Federal Law of 21.07.2014 No. 212-ФЗ “On the Fundamentals of Public Oversight in the Russian Federation”;
units.label: Point 17 Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 18) establish scientific and technical councils attached to local self-government bodies to ensure the municipality’s participation in implementing a unified state science and technology policy.
units.label: Point 18 Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Rights of local self-government bodies to exercise powers not assigned to local self-government bodies
units.text: 3. Local self-government bodies may exercise other powers where provided for by federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. Individual powers of local self-government bodies may temporarily be exercised by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation where:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1) because of a natural disaster, catastrophe or other emergency, the municipal representative body and local administration are absent and/or cannot be formed in accordance with this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2) decisions or actions (inaction) of local self-government bodies result in overdue municipal debt and/or budgetary obligations, determined in accordance with the procedure established by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation, exceeding 30 percent of the municipalities’ own budget revenues in the latest reporting year, and/or overdue municipal budgetary obligations exceeding 40 percent of budget appropriations in the reporting financial year, provided that the federal budget and budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation have fulfilled their budgetary obligations toward the budgets of those municipalities;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3) in exercising individual delegated state powers financed by subventions to local budgets, local self-government bodies have misused budget funds or violated the Constitution of the Russian Federation, a federal law or other regulatory legal acts, as established by the relevant court.
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. In the cases established by point 1 of part 1 of this Article, a decree (resolution) on the temporary exercise by executive bodies of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation of the corresponding powers of local self-government bodies is adopted by the highest official of the constituent entity on the basis of a decision of the representative body of local self-government or a decision of the constituent entity’s legislative body adopted by a majority of at least two thirds of the established number of deputies.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3. A decree (resolution) of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation on the temporary exercise by that constituent entity’s executive bodies of individual powers of local self-government bodies under part 2 of this Article must contain:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Temporary exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1) the name or names of the municipality or municipalities in which the exercise of individual powers of their local self-government bodies is temporarily assigned to executive bodies of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 38
